about: Named downtown towers drawn as authored landmarks in place of the generic kit facade (eo-landmarks skyline.rs), and the authored facade styles the landmark buildings' material kind 7 draws (eo-render landmarks_surface.wgsl `lm_authored`). Plans are the buildings' own footprint records in public/data/sf/sf-city.json (`record`); heights, materials and colours are the published values cited per entry. A value marked INFERRED has no published figure: it is chosen within the cited description and says so.
facadeKeys: moduleM: horizontal pitch of the window grid (m); finDepthM: how far the frame (fins, sunshades, reveals) stands proud of the glass, which hides the glass by the view angle; storeyM: vertical pitch (m); glazeX / glazeY: share of the module width / storey height that is glass; glassSrgb: the glazing's reflectance tint by day (drawn as a coated mirror: albedo x 0.85 metalness); glassRoughness; pattern: grid (punched or curtain wall), screen (an open lattice over a dark interior); nightLit: share of the city's lit-window fraction this facade's windows take at night; led: 1 for the Salesforce crown's light sculpture

solid.source: no window grid: a material that takes only the floodlight (the Transamerica spire's aluminium)

transamerica-window.source: frame depth INFERRED; the JS export's windowPitchM 3 and floorM 4.065 (data/landmarks-js.json transamerica-pyramid dimensions); the window quads are the openings, so the whole quad is glass but its mullion share. Tint INFERRED: the export's glassSrgb 0x29323a lightened to a coated pane's reflectance (Wikipedia, Transamerica Pyramid: 3,678 windows)

v3.source: reflectance: float glass, about 4 % at each of its two faces at normal incidence (Fresnel, n = 1.52); the dark room behind INFERRED; nightLit 0.6 of the evening occupancy, so 30-50 % of the office bays are lit at 21 h (INFERRED); a lit office window 3.2 cd/m2 seen through the pane (INFERRED: kept under the night exposure's clip, below the 10-30 cd/m2 of a 500 lux office behind clear glass)

transamerica-far.source: frame depth INFERRED; the far item's walls: the export's window band (windowBandM 1.7 of floorM 4.065) and pitch (windowPitchM 3), so the window share of the facade's far tone and its lit windows at night match the near windows

salesforce-curtain.source: module 5 ft (1.524 m) and fin share 0.22 from the export's fin-curtain surface (landmark-surface.js); storey 277.98 m / 61 floors (export topFloorM, floors); the sunshade band per floor, 0.6 m of 4.56 m, from the export's spandrel. Pelli Clarke Pelli (architectmagazine.com project gallery): 'clear glass with pearlescent metal accents', 'each floor ... integrated metal sunshades'; Wikipedia: 'white aluminum fins and perforated sunshades, which reach up to two feet beyond the glass skin' (finDepthM 0.61). Clear low-e glass: tint INFERRED from the export's glassSrgb 0x8f9ca5

v3.source: glazeY: vision glass to a 10 ft (3.05 m) office ceiling of the 4.557 m storey, the slab edge and plenum an opaque spandrel behind the pearl sunshade (WBDG, curtain walls: spandrel panels hide the areas between vision glass; the ceiling height INFERRED); Guardian Glass (Salesforce Tower project page): 'neutral-looking' double glazing with high solar protection. reflectance: a clear low-e insulating unit reflects 11-13 % of visible light outside (glass makers' data sheets for clear solar-control low-e units); the room behind INFERRED; the pane set-out tilt INFERRED (unitised panels hung within a fraction of a degree); the lighting bay two modules (3 m, a usual office ceiling grid) INFERRED; nightLit and windowCd as transamerica-window

salesforce-crown.source: frame depth INFERRED; Pelli Clarke Pelli: 'the walls rise past the top floor to form a transparent crown that appears to dissolve into the sky'; Wikipedia: the top 150 ft (46 m) above the 61st floor are largely ornamental, a nine-storey light sculpture (Jim Campbell, Day for Night, 2018) of 11,000 inward-facing LEDs on the top six floors and colour lighting on the three below. The open share of the lattice (0.55 x 0.55 of a 1.524 m module) is INFERRED

v3.source: the crown keeps its screen; its sculpture's luminance is v3Night

carnelian-bays.source: frame depth INFERRED; SOM, 555 California Street (som.com projects): 'polished red Carnelian granite' and 'faceted bronze-tinted bay windows'; storey 779 ft (237.4 m) / 52 floors (Wikipedia, 555 California Street). The module is half the footprint record's bay facet (about 2.7 m between the sawtooth's points). Bronze tint and the glass share INFERRED

v3.source: SOM: faceted bronze-tinted bay windows. Reflectance: bronze-tinted solar glass 8-12 % outside (glass makers' data sheets); the warm chroma of its reflection and the room behind INFERRED; night as transamerica-window

embarcadero-ribs.source: frame depth INFERRED; SFYIMBY, 'Number 19: One Embarcadero Center': 'a repetition of concrete and glass panels, with vertical concrete stripes that protrude slightly from the window plane'; Docomomo US register, Embarcadero Center: precast concrete facades. Storey 568 ft (173.1 m) / 45 floors (Wikipedia, Embarcadero Center). Module, glass share and the dark tint INFERRED

v3.source: SFYIMBY: vertical concrete stripes that protrude from the window plane: the glass and its dark spandrel panels drawn as one recessed strip (glazeY 0.92) between ribs standing 0.45 m proud (INFERRED), so the slabs read as vertical stripes; reflectance: tinted float glass of the early 1970s, about 8-10 % (INFERRED from the Fresnel reflectance of float glass and a grey tint); night as salesforce-curtain

california-345.source: frame depth INFERRED; Wikipedia, 345 California Center: 48 storeys, roof 620 ft (189.0 m); buildingsdb.com: a granite and glass window wall with large square windows. Storey 189.0 m / 48; module and tint INFERRED

millennium-glass.source: frame depth INFERRED; Wikipedia, Millennium Tower (San Francisco): 'blue-gray glass', roof 605 ft (184.4 m), 58 floors above ground. Storey 184.4 m / 58; module INFERRED

v3.source: Wikipedia: blue-gray glass; its reflectance (a reflective blue-grey low-e unit, 14-18 %) INFERRED; homes lit in the evening, so a larger share than the offices (INFERRED)

fremont-181.source: frame depth INFERRED; Permasteelisa Group, 181 Fremont project page: a unitised glass curtain wall over large diagonal columns; buildingsdb.com: Solarban 70XL low-e glass, green-tinted, the diagonal trussed beams coated in aluminium. Storey 700 ft (213.4 m) / 57 floors (Wikipedia, 181 Fremont); module INFERRED

v3.source: buildingsdb.com: Solarban 70XL low-e glass; reflectance about 11 % outside (PPG publishes 11-12 % exterior visible reflectance for Solarban 70XL units); night as salesforce-curtain

city-hall-window.source: frame depth INFERRED; the export's window quads (data/landmarks-js.json city-hall: windowSrgb 0x23272b), each a whole opening; lit share at night INFERRED (a civic building, fewer late offices)

v3.source: reflectance as transamerica-window (single float glass); old crown glass sits less flat (tilt INFERRED); the night lighting's floor the base storey (landmarks-js.json city-hall baseStoreyM 8.5), so the window rows light apart

v3Night.source: Day for Night (Jim Campbell, 2018; Wikipedia, Salesforce Tower): 11,000 LEDs behind the crown's screen, low-resolution moving figures on the top six of its nine storeys, a colour field on the three below. Luminance INFERRED: the wash about the shaft's mean at 21 h (1.1 cd/m2: 40 % of bays lit at 3.2 cd/m2 over 70 % glass), the figures peaking near twice a lit window's 3.2 (3.4), both under the night exposure's clip

floodlight.source: IES Lighting Handbook, floodlighting illuminance recommendations for building facades: light surfaces (reflectance 70-85 %) 5 fc (50 lux) in dark surroundings to 15 fc (150 lux) in bright surroundings; medium-light surfaces 10 to 20 fc. Colour: a 3,500 K metal-halide / LED floodlight, INFERRED

buildings.name: 555 California Street
buildings.source: Wikipedia, 555 California Street: 779 ft (237 m) roof, 52 floors, 'clad in costly polished or rough carnelian granite', 'thousands of bay windows'. SOM: 'polished red Carnelian granite', 'faceted bronze-tinted bay windows'. The record's height (166.4 m) is under the published roof; the published value is drawn. Granite tone INFERRED (a polished dark red-brown granite); penthouse INFERRED

v3.source: Wikipedia: polished carnelian granite; SOM: polished red Carnelian granite. Albedo INFERRED: a dark red-brown polished granite, linear 0.037 (sRGB #3b3532: dark granites reflect 5-15 % of light, the polished face reading darker than its honed colour), desaturated (the v2 tone was a saturated maroon); polished stone a smooth dielectric (F0 0.04, roughness 0.2, INFERRED), so most of what the face shows is the sky it reflects (drawn in the glazing environment class)

buildings.name: One Embarcadero Center
buildings.source: Wikipedia, Embarcadero Center: One, 568 ft (173 m), 45 floors (1971). Profile: 'a series of thin slabs ascending in size toward the center' (architecture guide quoted in the search record); the tier heights and lengths (fractions of the height and of the plan's length) are INFERRED. Precast tone INFERRED (light precast concrete)

buildings.name: Two Embarcadero Center
buildings.source: Wikipedia, Embarcadero Center: Two, 413 ft (126 m), 30 floors (1974). Tiers INFERRED as for One

buildings.name: Three Embarcadero Center
buildings.source: Wikipedia, Embarcadero Center: Three, 413 ft (126 m), 31 floors (1977). Tiers INFERRED as for One

buildings.name: Four Embarcadero Center
buildings.source: Wikipedia, Embarcadero Center: Four, 571 ft (174 m), 45 floors (1982). Tiers INFERRED as for One

buildings.name: 345 California Center
buildings.source: Wikipedia, 345 California Center: 48 storeys, roof 620 ft (189 m), spire tips 721 ft (220 m); the top 11 floors (38-48) 'located in twin towers set at 45-degree angles to the rest of the building', the twin spires. buildingsdb.com: granite and glass. The shaft below the twin towers ends at floor 37 (0.77 of the roof height); the twin towers' plan (0.26 of the plan's length, square, at the plan's ends) and the granite tone are INFERRED

buildings.name: Millennium Tower
buildings.source: Wikipedia, Millennium Tower (San Francisco): roof 605 ft (184 m), antenna spire 645 ft (197 m), 58 floors above ground, 'blue-gray glass'. Mullion tone INFERRED

buildings.name: 181 Fremont
buildings.source: Wikipedia, 181 Fremont: roof 700 ft (213 m), a parapet / mechanical screen to 745 ft (227 m), spire to 802.5 ft (244.6 m), 57 floors. Permasteelisa: large diagonal columns behind the curtain wall; buildingsdb.com: the diagonal trussed beams coated in aluminium. The braces' span (8 storeys a bay) INFERRED

v3.source: Wikipedia, 181 Fremont: the mechanical screen to 745 ft (227.1 m), the spire to 802.5 ft (244.6 m). The screen's faces leaning in toward the spire (to 0.72 of the roof's plan) and the braces' cladding (1.8 m wide, 0.7 m proud) INFERRED from the description of its sloped crown and diagonal columns
